scope: Read-only analysis of already downloaded public bodies only. Zero new GETs, no new REA runs, no original execution, no browser/app changes.
method: Reused actual pinned REA6.4 semantic IR and verified retained SHA; exact method spans obtained with the pinned REA parser. All inferred contracts below remain static-source evidence.

quantity_formula.authoritative_consumer_target: this.calcComposite.getEcountCalcQty in eccomposite_v1.function.calc, used directly by prod_manager barcode accumulation.
quantity_formula.equation: When !isNoValue: Q = Decimal(E * U * M).toFixed(D, 4), returned as value.

variables.additional_column_active: columnList contains mapped uqty id with width > 0. This exact test is not simply an isHideColumn flag.
variables.E: If additional column active: Decimal(rowItem[mapped exch_rate] || 0); otherwise 1.
variables.U: If additional column active: Decimal(n.uqty || rowItem[mapped uqty] || 0); otherwise 1.
variables.M: Starts at1. If size_flag is1/2 and size_des is nonempty, evaluate the size expression. Flag2 first applies legacy conversion. Zero result or evaluation exception falls back to1.

conditions: isNoValue=true leaves value undefined and returns only the formula descriptor.
The uqty override uses a truthiness fallback; numeric0 and string0 are not identical inputs under this source expression.
getCalcParam maps the existing row through column IDs and supplies an exch_rate default of1 through its own truthiness fallback. Direct getEcountCalcQty fallback for absent rate is0.
The formula factor is rowItem mapped exch_rate. It is distinct from the header foreign-currency exchangeRate parameter assembled in getCalcParamDetail.
The source passes numeric rounding argument4 to Decimal.toFixed. The exact Decimal library build/rounding enum was not independently established in this bounded task.

mode3.name: 합산추가수량, using parent-observed label and matching source mode flags
contract: Only an eligible previous-row match with addQty=true and non-transfer action accumulates.
Increase that row UQTY by1. Compute deltaQ through getEcountCalcQty(getCalcParam(row) with uqty string1). Add the returned deltaQ to old QTY using Decimal.
The direct source rounds/formats the one-unit delta before adding it; it does not directly recompute QTY from the new total UQTY in this helper. Subsequent cell-change calculations remain external.
When originKey exists and is nonempty, clear the origin product-code cell. Serial linkage may be appended/refreshed.

mode4.name: 개별추가수량, using parent-observed label and matching source mode flags
contract: cehckAddQty disables previous-row merging for mode4.
setProdProcess prepares UQTY=1 and QTY=0. setProdValue writes the uqty with isRunChange enabled for non-transfer actions, allowing the form/calc event pipeline to perform quantity conversion.
Temporary prepared QTY=0 does not prove final QTY=0. Final conversion depends on configured columns, product parameters and registered calculation/default handlers.
Skip if no serial composite or for manufactured items.

In modes3/4, SL_ANYINPUT_YN=false uses serial quantity1. Otherwise calculate the equivalent of one uqty; a Number(value) falsy result clears the serial index and refreshes a linked serial cell when applicable.
The serial helper forwards data to a serial composite; it does not establish server acceptance.

merge_restrictions.scope: The candidate is the immediately previous row relative to the insertion/current empty row selected by setRowKey, not a global sum of all equal product rows.
block_when: barcode cehckAddQty is false (disabled or individual modes2/4)
immediately preceding row product code differs from the resolved product code
incoming SERIAL_IDX is nonempty and previous QTY<0
previous serial_idx is nonempty and incoming SERIAL_IDX is empty
previous serial_idx is nonempty, SL_ANYINPUT_YN=false, and incoming SERIAL_IDX equals that previous serial_idx

additional_serial_guards.applies_when: gridId is neither bor nor bom and a serial composite exists
rules: Let serialDataEmpty be whether stored serial data for the previous row serial key is empty. Let warehouseEmpty be the popup warehouse composite value being empty, when that composite exists.
If getIsUnCheckWhCd() is not true AND serialDataEmpty AND incoming SERIAL_SEARCH_YN is true, block when warehouseEmpty is false; when warehouseEmpty is true, block only if USE_SERIAL_WH is true.
additional_serial_guards.limit: The meanings and private configuration values behind serial/warehouse predicates are not observed.

transfer_contract: setRowKey and calcProdQtySum both explicitly bypass barcode merging for transfer.
setProdValue disables ordinary uqty change handling on transfer; basic qty change handling has its own cbPriceFlag branch. Transferred quantities must not be treated as normal barcode scans.
merge_restrictions.comparison: The small checkSameProdByRowKey helper compares only resolved product code to the previous mapped prod_cd field; this is not proof that all upstream code ignores specification/name/serial differences.

our_extra_qty_ratio_mapping.reason: No explicit binding from ECOUNT fields to our item extraQtyNumerator/extraQtyDenominator is present in the inspected quantity source. ECOUNT uses a mapped row exch_rate plus an optional row-dependent size expression and form precision/visibility.
our_extra_qty_ratio_mapping.conditional_mathematical_subset: A deliberately configured own-app N/D factor can represent E only in a constrained case where the uqty column is active, M=1, N/D is independently verified as the same row unit rate, and decimal/rounding behavior agrees. This is an own-model mapping assumption, not an observed native ECOUNT field mapping.
do_not_assume: Do not infer N and D from EXCH_RATE2/DENO_RATE found in product-price data; their relationship to this quantity helper is not established.
Do not assume one additional quantity equals one basic quantity.
Do not use a fixed per-item fraction to claim equivalence for row-dependent size formulas, column visibility or serial-dependent behavior.
Do not silently map missing original unit data to an invented conversion factor.

companion_helper.difference: The inventorylib.common helper has a different rowItem signature and always multiplies rowItem.exchRate * rowItem.uqty * sizeMultiplier; it lacks the composite helper uqty-column visibility branch. The barcode consumer calls the composite helper, so these two functions must not be conflated.

unknowns: Product unit-rate and size-formula business values, calcByString grammar and the exact Decimal library are not inspected or executed.
The complete form/default event chain deciding mode4 final QTY is only partially recovered; a write-with-change call is not proof of a specific final number.
No original serial/warehouse settings, scan, transfer, save or server result was observed in this task.
